suspendConfirm.heading: Suspend tenant?
suspendConfirm.body: "{{name}}" and all its users will be locked out immediately. You can resume access at any time.

resumeConfirm.heading: Resume tenant?
resumeConfirm.body: "{{name}}" and its users will regain access immediately.

access.title: How users sign in
access.organizationHint: Users type this slug in the Organization field on the tenant sign-in page. Leaving it empty signs them in to the default tenant.
access.suspendedHint: Sign-in is rejected for every user of this tenant with the same 401 as a wrong password — no separate message leaks the tenant state.
access.adminHint: Created together with the tenant, with the password set by the operator (invite flow is planned for MT-4).
